provenance.non_nasa_scope: The NASA catalog (docs/product/NASA-SOURCES.md, docs/product/sources.csv, docs/product/nasa-data/) holds no camera photoplethysmography method, frequency band or signal quality limit, so the algorithm and its limits cite the non-NASA papers in sources; every limit is a team default, not a measured accuracy claim

min_rate_hz.basis: Nyquist margin above the 3 Hz pulse band edge; POS was evaluated at 20 frames per second (Wang 2017); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

max_gap_ms.basis: a gap longer than one quarter second loses a whole beat at the band edge; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

min_luma.basis: dim faces give colour traces dominated by sensor noise; venue lighting per DEMO-PLAN 60-66; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

max_saturated_fraction.basis: clipped pixels carry no pulse colour change (AGENTS section 2 saturation check); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

max_face_motion.basis: face centre displacement as a fraction of the frame; seated still per DEMO-PLAN; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

max_torso_motion.basis: horizontal sway of the torso centre as a fraction of the frame; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

max_shoulder_excursion.basis: largest vertical excursion of the shoulder midpoint from its median, as a fraction of the frame: quiet breathing lifts the shoulders by millimetres, so a larger periodic bob is body motion (rocking, bobbing), not breathing; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

saturated_level.basis: 8 bit grey level at or above which a pixel counts as clipped by the sensor (AGENTS section 2 saturation check); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

face_region_margin.basis: skin region is the face box minus this fraction on every side (the central half), which keeps hair, background and eyes out of the colour mean as in Wang 2017's face skin region; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

min_landmark_visibility.basis: a shoulder landmark counts as visible when the landmark model's visibility score reaches this value (MediaPipe pose landmarker output, 0 to 1); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

settled_change_per_s.basis: 8 bit levels per second: the analysis window starts once the whole frame mean of every colour channel changes by no more than this against the frame one second earlier. Team measurement, one recording, not a published value: a MacBook FaceTime camera opened fresh (2026-11-15) ramped its auto exposure and white balance from R 75.9, G 67.3, B 65.1 to R 97.8, G 70.9, B 54.8 over its first 1.3 s (up to about 21 levels per second), then a still sitter in ordinary light changed by at most 1.95 levels per second over 24 s; a window holding the ramp read signal_quality_too_low and the same window without it read a pulse. NASA's catalog holds no camera method (provenance non_nasa_scope)

band_hz.basis: POS pass band starts at 0.7 Hz (Wang 2017); upper edge 3 Hz (180 /min) for a seated adult; a rate outside is refused, never clipped; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

window_s.basis: analysis window long enough for 0.05 Hz spectral resolution; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

min_coverage.basis: fraction of frames with exactly one face; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

min_snr_db.basis: de Haan 2013 SNR definition; signal power must at least equal the rest of the band; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

snr_halfwidth_hz.basis: de Haan 2013 uses a band around the fundamental and first harmonic; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

edge_margin_hz.basis: search beyond the band so a peak past the edge is seen and refused (V06); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

frequency_step_hz.basis: 0.3 /min grid, finer than the reported resolution; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

decimals.basis: pulse is reported in whole beats per minute (docs/product/api/examples/clinical/observation-pulse.json)

max_method_gap_per_min.basis: CHROM corroborates POS within the 5 /min camera pulse error target (DEPLOYMENT 688); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

band_hz.basis: 6 to 42 breaths per minute; a rate outside is refused, never clipped; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

window_s.basis: at least three breaths at the slowest band rate; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

min_coverage.basis: fraction of frames with both shoulders visible (PRD R09); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

min_snr_db.basis: same SNR definition as pulse; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

snr_halfwidth_hz.basis: narrower than the pulse band to match slower breathing; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

edge_margin_hz.basis: search beyond the band so a peak past the edge is refused (V06); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

frequency_step_hz.basis: 0.12 /min grid; team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

decimals.basis: breaths per minute are counted whole (PRD 616 counted breaths)

agreement_tolerance_per_min.basis: views agree within 2 /min (docs/product/api/examples/clinical/measurement-request-pulse.json quality note); team default pending the coordinator's camera policy (PLAN C3); not a measured accuracy claim

reasons.time_discontinuous: the camera clock jumped during the reading
reasons.overexposed: too much light on the face
reasons.outside_analysis_range: outside the range the camera can read
reasons.not_paired: this camera is not paired with this person
reasons.ambiguous_subject: more than one face in view
reasons.camera_not_settled: the camera's picture was still adjusting to the light
reasons.window_missed: the reading window had already passed
reasons.origin_mismatch: this camera's source does not match the check
